\[
E_s(p) = \sum_{|q|_\infty \le w} \left(I(p + q) - I(p + q + s)\right)^2,\qquad R(p) = \min_{s} E_s(p)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(E_s\): The change of the window for the shift s
- \(w\): The window half width

The shifts s are (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1) and (-1, 1), the four directions that Harris and Stephens list for Moravec's operator. Values are on a 0 to 1 scale and w is the window half width. A flat area changes for no shift, an edge for some, and a corner for all, so the smallest change marks corners. The corners output keeps pixels whose response is at least the threshold and the largest within the minimum distance. Plateaus keep every pixel. skimage.feature.corner_moravec compares only the four diagonal shifts, so it gives other values.
